law_name: Law on Copyright and Related Rights (2010)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 70 years (collective works: 70 years from lawful publication)
moral_rights: Personal (moral) rights incl. right of repentance/withdrawal
orphan_works: No specific orphan-works mechanism in Law 63/10; Directive 2012/28/EU not transposed (per Hasić academic analysis)
digital_protection: Protection against circumvention of technological measures (2010 Act)

enforcement_body: Institute for Intellectual Property of Bosnia and Herzegovina
